subject.title: [Enhancement] Implement staggered jittered reconnect retries in Channel Health Monitor

question: Should Channel Health Monitor only stagger unhealthy-account launches within a monitor pass, or also own a second exponential delay across successive fresh recovery cycles?
rationale: Current main already has jittered exponential per-account retries and tests intentionally reset that retry state after exhaustion, so adding monitor-level exponential backoff changes the availability-versus-rate-limit policy.

options.title: Stagger launches only
options.body: Add a small bounded jitter between eligible recovery launches in the same monitor pass while preserving existing cooldown, hourly cap, and fresh-recovery semantics.

options.title: Add monitor backoff
options.body: Introduce a second exponential delay across health-monitor recovery cycles and accept slower recovery after ChannelManager retries are exhausted.

options.title: Require incident proof
options.body: Keep current behavior until timing logs or a deterministic scenario demonstrate harmful synchronized launches.

recommendation.title: Stagger launches only
recommendation.body: Add a small bounded jitter between eligible recovery launches in the same monitor pass while preserving existing cooldown, hourly cap, and fresh-recovery semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the original behavior and has the strongest ongoing history across the monitor and ChannelManager decision surface.
